text:
ana: dropping a quick design thread  proposal: add a lightweight "Cohort compare" mode to the heatmap so users can compare p95 across two cohorts (e.g., model v1 vs v2, region us-west vs eu). UI idea: a small toggle next to the timepicker that opens a second heatmap overlay with adjustable opacity and a compact legend showing deltas

priya: love it. two asks: 1) allow cohort selection from existing filters (so we can quickly pick traffic split by model tag), 2) keyboard shortcut to toggle compare mode (thinking `c`) :keyboard:

sam: accessibility first: overlay must maintain contrast when opacity changes. also ensure the delta legend has textual descriptions for screen readers (e.g., "v2 p95 is +34ms compared to v1"). provide an `aria-live` summary when compare mode is enabled

tom: interaction detail: default overlay to 40% opacity and dashed outline on the active cohort. include a small mini-map scrubber that highlights matching buckets between cohorts when hovering. micro-snippet:

```
// toggle compare
openCompare(base=CohortA, compare=CohortB)
renderOverlay(opacity=0.4, outline='dashed')
onHover(syncBuckets)
```

emily: copy nits: label the toggle "Compare cohorts" not "Diff"  clearer for product folks. in the legend show "Cohort A: v1" and "Cohort B: v2 (est. +34ms)". if sampling in either cohort, append "(sampled)" to the label

sara: a11y & keyboard flow: keyboard users should be able to: Tab to timepicker, press `c` to open compare, arrow to pick a cohort, Enter to apply. when applied announce summary via `aria-live`: "Comparison enabled: v2 p95 is 34ms higher across selected range". also ensure colorblind-safe palette for overlays (use pattern + color)

ana: small UX edge-case: when cohorts have very different volume, computed deltas might be noisy. propose showing a confidence hint: "Delta may be based on N samples / low volume" and grey out delta if sample count < threshold. also add a small "normalize by throughput" checkbox in the compare header for advanced users

priya: implementation ask: keep compare data client-side for responsiveness and cap comparison windows to 7d for initial rollout. lazy-load detailed per-bucket diffs only on demand ("Show diffs") to avoid exploding time-series queries

tom: debounce hover sync at 200ms, cap mini-map fetches to 5 buckets. telemetry events: `compare_opened`, `compare_applied`, `compare_deltas_viewed`

emily: microcopy for low-volume hint: "Delta may be unreliable (sample size: N). Click to see raw counts."  keeps PMs honest and avoids misinterpretation

sara: accessibility test case to add: screen-reader should announce when compare overlay appears and then allow exploring cohorts via keyboard: "Use arrow keys to move between buckets. Press Enter to pin bucket for side-by-side metrics." add that to acceptance criteria

ux-bot: staging preview uploaded: https://staging-console.redwood-inference.com/cohort-compare (expires in 72h) :rocket:

ana: acceptance checklist I'll add to the ticket: 1) keyboard shortcut `c` documented, 2) aria-live summary for compare enable/disable, 3) color+pattern overlay for colorblind support, 4) low-volume confidence messaging, 5) debounce/cap for client-side fetches, 6) telemetry events. I'll update Figma and post mocks by EOD. thanks! :thumbsup:
